svg.title: AIcoach — Upload and analysing (r3-03)
svg.text: Upload: one sentence from the coach, one drop zone, six essentials. Nothing else on the page.

g.text: or choose a file · mp4 or mov · max 15 s · one swing
From behind, along the target line
On your bag or a tripod
120 fps if your phone has it
Whole body and club in frame
Head to clubhead, the whole swing
Trim to one swing, max 15 s
Off by default. If on, the clip is stored on the AIcoach server until you delete it.

svg.text: Analysing: the step log streams in, key frames pin as they are found, and the four steps are announced.
